Project-owned override: Arc's package-graph specs pack Release outputs with --no-build --no-restore.
The preceding Debug build restores net10.0 only. Prepare the Release package graph immediately before specs, as package-graph-verification.yml does.
Keep every Debug spec enabled and propagate any prerequisite or test failure.

gates.description: Prepare Release package outputs, then run all Debug specs — zero failures
command: set -euo pipefail; dotnet build Source/DotNET/Cratis/Cratis.csproj --configuration Release; dotnet build Source/DotNET/Cratis.CodeAnalysis/Cratis.CodeAnalysis.csproj --configuration Release; dotnet test --configuration Debug --no-build
